facts.why: At the cafe Ann asks for champagne and Joe has cold coffee, and Joe remarks on champagne for lunch, so it is a midday drink, not before noon.
facts.full: Ann's order at the café. Joe gets cold coffee.

vibe.verdict: A stylish bistro with the gelato, the Vespa and the barge fight in the right places, though it skips Joe's pajamas and the last line.
missing: Joe's pajamas on Ann ('This is my room')
'Rome. By all means, Rome.' (the last line)
The Mouth of Truth hand gag
Irving's lighter camera at the press conference
